snippet.title: VOXEL PLAYGROUND - GAME UPDATE - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Voxel Playground is coming to Steam with a major new update! Unleash even more creativity on PC with a brand-new map, new items, and new mods. Build, experiment, and explore endless possibilities in this voxel-based sandbox playground.
